name: logPHIReadAccess
shortDescription: Records an audit entry for every access to Protected Health Information (PHI) in MedicalRecords.
description:
Overview

Creates an immutable audit log entry whenever a MedicalRecord (containing PHI) is accessed, detailing who accessed it and when, for compliance.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler whenever a MedicalRecord is read by any user or system process. It receives context about the accessed record and the accessor.

Logic

  1. Extract the idOfUser (accessor), patientId, and medicalRecordId from the event context.
  2. Create an AuditLog entry using ctx.audit.log with action='read', resourceType='MedicalRecord', the medicalRecordId as resourceId, and a context dictionary including patientId and accessorId.
  3. Ensure the log entry is marked with a type='CRITICAL' for PHI access to highlight its importance for compliance.

Entities

  • AuditLog
  • MedicalRecord
